goals: Verify that the index page is served correctly and contains a valid MSAL CDN link
Verify that the MSAL configuration object is defined, contains a valid authority URI, and is sanitized of real credentials
activities: Set the document HTML to the contents of the index.html file
Retrieve the 'src' attribute of the element with ID 'load-msal'
Verify that the 'src' attribute contains the expected MSAL CDN link
Load the MSAL configuration object into the global scope
Verify that the MSAL configuration object is defined
Check if the client ID in the configuration matches a GUID regular expression
Verify that the client ID does not match the GUID format
Check if the authority in the configuration matches a URI regular expression
Verify that the authority matches the URI format
Set the Node environment variable to 'test'
Send a GET request to the root ('/') endpoint
Read the contents of the index.html file
Verify that the response status code is 200
Verify that the response text matches the contents of the index.html file
